Description: Maintain the list of domains and SSL endpoints to be monitored. Related requirements: FR-002
Run daily WHOIS/RDAP registration checks and TLS certificate audits; store timestamped results. Related requirements: FR-001, FR-003
Detect upcoming domain and certificate expiry and route threshold-based alerts. Related requirements: FR-001, FR-004
Review alert history and acknowledge alerts with an audit trail. Related requirements: FR-005

As a SysAdmin, I want to add a valid domain and its SSL endpoint to the monitoring list, so that the system knows which assets must be checked. Validate the domain and save its endpoint and enabled status. Related requirement: FR-002

Summary: Update or disable a monitored domain
Description: As a SysAdmin, I want to update domain details or disable an obsolete domain, so that the monitoring list stays accurate. Allow authorized edits and enable/disable actions. Related requirement: FR-002

As a SysAdmin, I want to have the system retrieve registration and expiry information daily, so that domain expiry can be detected early. Store available registrar and expiry data, timestamp and lookup status. Related requirement: FR-003

As a SysAdmin, I want to have the system perform a TLS handshake and extract certificate expiry, so that SSL certificates can be renewed before they expire. Connect to each SSL endpoint and store certificate validity end date. Related requirement: FR-001

As a SysAdmin, I want to have the system detect 30-, 15- and 3-day certificate thresholds, so that the team receives advance warning. Compare certificate expiry dates with configured thresholds and create alerts. Related requirement: FR-001

As a SysAdmin, I want to have the system route domain expiry alerts through the escalation ladder, so that domains are renewed before registration expires. Evaluate domain expiry and route alerts to configured escalation recipients. Related requirement: FR-004

As a Security Officer, I want to receive expiry alerts through the configured notification channel, so that I can act on risks promptly. Queue notifications and record queued, delivered or failed status. Related requirement: FR-004

As a Security Officer, I want to view current and previous domain and certificate alerts, so that I can review unresolved and past risks. Display alert type, domain, threshold, time, escalation level and status. Related requirement: FR-005

As a SysAdmin, I want to acknowledge an alert with my identity and acknowledgement time, so that the team can track ownership. Record authorized acknowledgement and timestamp; reject unauthorized attempts. Related requirement: FR-005
